$comment: Deliberately invalid versioned sentinel: the image is not built, no file is published and no checksum is computed.
license: Fedora Linux packages: their respective open-source licenses
provenance: built locally by images/fedora-44-x86-64/build.sh with FLAVOR=xfce (dnf --installroot against the Fedora 44 repositories); never versioned, never distributed
notes: The ISO, vmlinuz and initrd.img are never committed to the repository.

The real manifest.json is generated by images/fedora-44-x86-64/build.sh (FLAVOR=xfce) into the Git-ignored webroot apps/web/public/images/fedora-44-x86-64-xfce/; it carries the size and sha256 of every published file.
status only becomes 'ready' after the smoke test and a real boot in v64.
